{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Fourteen Locks (grid reference [ ST277886] ) is a series of locks, also known as the Cefn Flight, on the Crumlin arm of the Monmouthshire Canal at Rogerstone in Newport, South Wales.","title":"Fourteen Locks"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The flight of locks was completed in 1799 and raises the water level 160 ft (50 m) in just 800 yd (740 m).","title":"Fourteen Locks"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" This is one of the steepest rises for a major run in the UK which, combined with the sheer number of locks, makes it one of the most significant in the country.","title":"Fourteen Locks"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The run of locks includes a series of embanked ponds, pounds, sluices and weirs to control the water supply, with no set of gates shared between individual locks.","title":"Fourteen Locks"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" It therefore comprises a flight of locks rather than a lock staircase.","title":"Fourteen Locks"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Her father is of English descent while her mother is of Irish descent.","title":"Sara Baume"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" As her parents travelled around in a caravan, Sara Baume was born \"on the road to Wigan Pier\".","title":"Sara Baume"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" When she was 4, they moved to County Cork, Ireland.","title":"Sara Baume"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" She studied fine art at Dun Laoghaire College of Art and Design and creative writing at Trinity College, Dublin from where she was awareded her MPhil.","title":"Sara Baume"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" She has received a Literary Fellowship from the Lannan Foundation in Santa Fe, New Mexico.","title":"Sara Baume"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" Her books are published by Tramp Press in Ireland and Heinemann in Britain.","title":"Sara Baume"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"Sara Baume was born near the canal on the flight of locks on which two other canals?"}
